intent: The model's hands and eyes: a typed page digest and tool surface no call can escape.
change: Page digest builder (stable element refs, accessible labels, bounded size with explicit truncation) and the Zod tool surface (navigate, click, type, select, read, ask_user, declare_outcome) executing against the provider Page beneath the s5 guardrail wrapper, with typed errors and task_events logging.
done_when: Unit tests prove digest stability, truncation marking, and label extraction on recorded fixture pages; integration tests via LocalProvider prove each tool's happy path, typed failures, stale-ref recovery, and a guardrail-rejected navigate.

proofs.claim: The composed proof fails before the toolset exists: the integration suite cannot resolve ./agentic/index.js.
Via LocalProvider against fixture pages: every tool happy path, typed failures, stale-ref recovery, and a guardrail-rejected navigate.
The pure rules: digest bounding marks truncation, rendering is stable, tool schemas refuse malformed input, and every failure kind has words for the model.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: The fallback brain: a budgeted Claude tool loop that cannot lie about outcomes or spend.
change: AgenticRunner registered as the playbook-registry fallback: claude-opus-5 tool loop over the toolset, hard budgets (tool calls, tokens, wall time) enforced in code, ask_user wired to the UserIO gate with resume-context summarization, declare_outcome mapping to task terminal states, per-mission token and cost logging on the task, API retry-with-backoff inside the wall budget, scripted LLM transport for tests.
done_when: Integration tests with the scripted transport prove outcome mapping for each declare_outcome class, budget exhaustion on each axis ending failed with cost still logged, guardrail-rejection flow (one tool error then failed), and malformed-argument re-ask bounded by the call budget.

proofs.claim: The composed proof fails before the runner exists: the integration suite cannot resolve ./agentic/runner.js.

Through the s5 engine on a toy fixture with the scripted transport: registry fallthrough, every declare_outcome class, ask_user park and resume with prior context, each budget axis ending failed with cost on the row, one guardrail error then failed, malformed arguments re-asked within the call budget, API retry then observable failure.

The pure rules: token and cost arithmetic, budget accounting, the mission brief and prior-run summary, the model call's retry classification and tool shapes, the start-URL and secret redaction rules, and the registry's unmatched-versus-refused choice.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: The whole fallback path proven: no playbook, real loop, honest ending, cost on the tab.
change: The composed proof suite on fixtures via LocalProvider: scripted-transport missions through success-with-evidence, ask_user park-and-resume with a fresh mission, blocked and hard-blocked endings, and event-trail plus cost assertions; one live-LLM smoke against a fixture behind the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY gate.
done_when: Integration tests prove the full success path (fixture state changed, tool-call trail in task_events, cost logged), waiting_user resume, blocked/hard-blocked missions ending failed or escalated with site state untouched; the live smoke completes a fixture mission with a real model when the key is present.

proofs.claim: The composed proof fails before the live gate exists: the fakegym mission suite cannot resolve ./agentic/live.js.

Against the fakegym fixture through the s5 engine with the scripted transport: the whole cancellation with the confirmation-code ask parking the task and the reply resuming it, the member cancelled and cost on the row; hard-blocked ending blocked, and ending blocked after an escalation ask, the membership untouched; the blocked shell seen through by the browser; the redesign's partner redirect refused by the allowlist; and the live smoke, skipping with its reason when the key or the opt-in is absent.
The live opt-in gate: skipped without the flag, skipped without the key, running only with both.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: Behavior pinned down as scenarios: what the loop must do, must refuse, and must never fake.
change: The eval runner, scenario format (fixture setup, goal, expected outcome class, post-state assertions), and the starting suite: success cancellation, success extraction, blocked, hard-blocked, redesign-mode layout shift, payment-trap guardrail firing - all runnable with the scripted transport; errored-vs-failed accounting.
done_when: The scripted suite runs green locally with outcome-class and control-plane state assertions per scenario; unit tests cover outcome classification and errored-vs-failed accounting; a sabotaged-prompt regression test proves named scenarios fail when the loop degrades.

proofs.claim: The composed proof fails before the harness exists: the scripted eval suite cannot resolve ./outcome.js.

Every scenario of the starting suite passes through the production path with the model played from its script, outcome class and control-plane state both; a loop with its digest put out fails the named scenarios; a scenario that cannot be set up is errored, not failed.
Outcome classification from a settled timeline, verdicts against the expected classes, errored-vs-failed accounting and the baseline comparison.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: The ratchet: no prompt or tool change lands unevaluated, and model drift is caught nightly.
change: CI wiring running the scripted eval suite on every push touching agentic code; the nightly workflow running the live-LLM suite under the spend cap against the committed baseline file, failing below baseline; baseline-update-by-PR convention documented.
done_when: CI proves the scripted suite blocks a deliberately regressed branch; the nightly workflow runs the live suite and fails when a scenario drops below baseline (proven by a baseline manipulation test), with errored scenarios reported distinctly.

proofs.claim: The composed proof fails before the nightly exists: the unit suite cannot resolve ./nightly.js.

The committed baseline lists exactly the starting suite; the spend meter and cap; the nightly report exits 1 on a regression or an unrun scenario and 0 once the baseline file is lowered to match (the bar is the file), reports errored scenarios apart from failed with their baseline entry standing, lists improvements for a PR without writing them; the scripted suite is in the gate that runs on every push; the nightly workflow runs the live suite under the cap behind the key guard.

Under the spend cap on the production path: a run that spends the cap leaves every later scenario errored and unrun, and under a cap nothing reaches the whole starting suite goes through and stands at the committed baseline.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: A budget the trail cannot reconcile and a secret the outcome can carry are the two ways the mission's own accounting misleads its consumers.
change: The tool-call budget counts tool calls: every tool the model asks for spends one, checked before each tool as well as before each turn, and a turn that asks for none spends one so it still runs out; the brief tells the model the same number. Every outcome the model authors - the declared evidence, the question it asks, the failure reason after a second violation - goes through the same secret redaction as the trail before it reaches the task row. The cost write goes through a recordTaskLlmUsage helper in @chief-of-staff/db beside recordBrowserSession, and playbooks no longer depends on drizzle-orm.
done_when: The runner suite proves a batched turn cannot spend past the tool-call budget (the budget event's count matches the tool steps on the trail) and that a declared outcome and an asked question carrying the password reach the row and the person redacted; the budget unit suite proves the axis is checked before a tool; the gate is green.

proofs.claim: Before the repair, a turn that batches more tools than the budget leaves runs them all and the mission goes on, and the password the model writes into its declared outcome and its question reaches the task row and the person unredacted.

expected.failure_signature: counts every tool call of a batched turn

proofs.claim: A batched turn cannot spend past the tool-call budget: the budget event's count is the number of tool steps on the trail, and a turn that used no tool still spends one; the declared outcome and the asked question reach the row and the person with the password struck out; the earlier budget, guardrail, malformed-call and cost proofs still hold with the cost written through the db helper.
checkBudgets counts tool calls before a turn and before a tool, never when asked about tokens; the brief tells the model its tool-call budget in those words; the db barrel exports recordTaskLlmUsage.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.

intent: A navigation that fails for the last failure's reason, not its own, misleads the model and flakes the gate.
change: The toolset asks a navigation once more when Chromium's own error page from the last wire failure lands in the middle of it, recognised from Playwright's sentence; the settle after a failure stays as the first line of defence.
done_when: The unit suite proves the collision is recognised from Playwright's sentence and nothing else; the toolset integration suite proves a navigate straight after an unsettled wire failure still lands on the page; the gate is green.

proofs.claim: Before the repair, the toolset has no notion of Chromium's late error page interrupting the next navigation, so a navigate asked straight after a wire failure can fail for that reason.

expected.failure_signature: recognises the late error page of Chromium

proofs.claim: A navigate asked straight after an unsettled wire failure still lands on the page, alongside every other tool proof against the fixtures.
The collision is recognised from Playwright's sentence and nothing else, alongside the rest of the tool surface's pure rules.
The workspace gate: lint, typecheck, unit and integration suites with coverage thresholds, build.
